calls.video_title: Down Over 90%, Is it Finally Time to Buy This AI Stock?
calls.thesis: AI lending platform down ~93% from ATH at forward P/E 6.8; bank charter expected 2027 would lower loan funding costs like SoFi's. He reiterates his buy ranking, but only for investors with the highest risk tolerance.
calls.bull_case: DCF $58 vs $24; could more than double in 12-18 months as the bank charter cuts funding costs and makes Upstart more competitive.
calls.bear_case: Macro index at 1.5: consumers 50% more likely to default than pre-COVID; rising rates plus weak balance sheets hit personal loans first (first to default); 2022-style revenue collapse risk.
